name: bigbosslive
description: BigBoss Live — live-streaming social platform (backend, admin dashboard, mini-games, Flutter app).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bigboss/shared && npm run build -w backend -w admin -w games
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
